title: Planck's abstract: Ωc h² = 0.120 ± 0.001 and Ωb h² = 0.0224 ± 0.0001
summary: The abstract quotes 68 percent regions for dark-matter density, baryon density, the scalar index, and the optical depth.
body: The abstract of Planck 2018 results VI says a combined analysis gives dark matter density Ωc h² = 0.120 ± 0.001, baryon density Ωb h² = 0.0224 ± 0.0001, scalar spectral index ns = 0.965 ± 0.004, and optical depth τ = 0.054 ± 0.007, and that in the abstract the collaboration quotes 68 percent confidence regions on measured parameters. These are the abstract's rounded figures. The Hubble constant and the matter density Ωm from this paper are already on the existing big-bang card and are not repeated here.
